ANSI.SYS.note: Exact output, blocking and nonblocking input, flush, generic IOCTL, and all pass-through request statuses are asserted through the live driver, including rejection at the corrected dispatch boundary

APPEND.EXE.note: Exact payloads prove resident OPEN and explicit-path lookup; /X transitions gate FIND and EXEC, /E exposes environment-backed state and is diagnosed after installation, invalid mode values produce exact diagnostics, and clearing removes the resident path

ASSIGN.COM.note: Resident redirection, /STATUS reporting, physical-drive restoration, duplicate and unknown switches, unpaired mappings, exact diagnostics, errorlevel 1, and state preservation after rejected updates are asserted

ATTRIB.EXE.note: Attribute set/clear, combined and recursive behavior, missing-file and invalid-switch errors, payload preservation, and cleanup on a disposable file are asserted; deployed archive-bit changes are also required by the BACKUP /M contract

BACKUP.COM.note: All seven switches, filtering, recursive, append, format, and log effects are asserted with binary-exact restoration; repeated flag switches are proven idempotent, while repeated valued switches plus unknown, excess-operand, invalid-date, and invalid-time forms require exact diagnostics and nonzero errorlevels

CHKDSK.COM.note: Reporting and /F repair of an injected three-cluster orphan chain are asserted, including exact recovered payloads, preservation of a referenced file, and a clean post-repair scan

COMMAND.COM.note: All 37 live COMTAB entries, built-in operational switches, and six startup switches are structurally traced; aliases, batch grammar, parser failures, pagination, deletion confirmation, COPY byte and failure-state semantics, environment mutation, date/time state, critical-error policy, resident messages, permanent-shell behavior, and LOADHIGH/LH upper-memory execution with scoped /L regions, per-region minima, /S caps, and a callable retained TSR are asserted

COMP.COM.note: Equal, different-size, exact hexadecimal mismatch, ten-error limit, missing-file, and excess-filespec behavior are asserted; real DOS console tests prove both N return and Y-driven repeated comparison through fresh filename prompts

COUNTRY.SYS.note: Country loading and code-page interaction are asserted

DEBUG.COM.note: All twenty live source-dispatched commands and four EMS subcommands are traced; memory, file, arithmetic, assembly, real execution, port I/O, single-step/proceed state, and an EMM386 allocation/map/release lifecycle are asserted

DISKCOMP.COM.note: Matching and mismatching tracks, /1 and /8 individually and together, duplicate and unknown switches, excess drives, exact parser errorlevels, and the repeat workflow are asserted

DISKCOPY.COM.note: A host-side whole-image comparison proves every byte is copied except the documented regenerated volume serial; single-sided copying, duplicate and unknown switches, excess drives, exact parser errorlevels, and the repeat workflow are asserted

DISPLAY.SYS.note: Code page 850 is prepared, selected, and reported active; a focused DISPLAY-to-ANSI-to-BIOS stack also proves visible console effects and exact status for every pass-through handler plus the dispatch boundary

DOSKEY.COM.note: Installation and INT 2Fh/4800h and 4810h are exercised; redirected input, resident history, macros, $T queuing, Up/Down/Page/F7/F8/F9/Alt+F7 navigation, buffer sizing, edit modes, and reinstall clearing are asserted

DRIVER.SYS.note: Installed logical C: handles its media prompt, reads an existing payload, creates and reads back a second payload, and persists both exactly on the separate physical B: image. Generic IOCTL checks assert the documented /F:0, /F:1, /F:2, /F:7, and /F:9 geometries

EDLIN.COM.note: Editing operations, binary mode, and interactive open/list/quit are asserted

EMM386.EXE.note: Dual-purpose EXE loading, driver-time and runtime ON/OFF/AUTO states, W= parsing, configurable LIM handle and alternate-register capacity, enforced minimum remaining XMS and DMA-buffer reservations, M1-M9 plus FRAME= and /P page-frame selectors, B= conventional banking boundaries, collision-free sparse Pn= enumeration and mapping, LIM 4 partial-map saving, EMS allocation/mapping/aliasing/release, concurrent UMB isolation, rollback, and two consecutive warm-reset boots are asserted; M10-M14 still need a 512K-machine runtime gate and W=ON needs real Weitek hardware validation

EXE2BIN.EXE.note: Exact BIN copying, COM 100h-prefix removal, and prompted relocation by a supplied base segment are asserted byte-for-byte; missing and excess operands, missing files, invalid signature, nonzero initial SS, and invalid IP are rejected without unintended output files

EXPAND.EXE.note: Single and multiple SZDD sources expand byte-exactly to filenames or directories; restored extensions, dictionary matches, output beyond 64 KiB, help, wildcard and destination rejection, and corrupt-stream cleanup are asserted

SETUP.EXE.note: Fresh and upgrade installation from a live two-disk compressed set is asserted in QEMU, including disk swapping, complete and byte-exact payload expansion, startup-file creation or preservation, unrelated-file preservation, system transfer, and fixed-disk boot

FASTOPEN.EXE.note: A functional /X installation uses EMM386 expanded memory; a fixed-disk probe verifies the DOS multiplex hook, exact deep-path reads, directory-rename cache invalidation, stale-path failure, and repopulation under both names

FC.EXE.note: Text, explicit and extension-selected binary, abbreviation, case, line-number, whitespace, tab, resynchronization, and line-buffer modes are asserted; a deployed DOS-side comparison independently guards binary-exact BACKUP/RESTORE oracles; binary/line incompatibilities, unknown switches, excess filenames, missing files, and numeric parser boundaries require exact outcomes

FDISK.EXE.note: Primary, extended, and logical creation, requested-size bounds, containment, CHS/LBA consistency, EBR signature, unused-entry state, and errorlevel behavior are asserted

FILESYS.EXE.note: A purpose-built IFS is attached to C:, reported by exact name, and detached; duplicate attach, unknown IFS, repeat detach, and empty status are rejected, while the driver independently records exactly one request for every valid lifecycle phase

FIND.EXE.note: All eight combinations of the source-declared /V, /C, and /N modes are asserted, including count precedence; stdin, multiple files, idempotent duplicates, unknown switches, missing or extra search strings, and errors are covered

FLUSH13.EXE.note: The deployed utility completes status, disable, enable, policy update, extended cache occupancy, and explicit flush operations against real absolute-sector I/O

FORMAT.COM.note: Safe, quick, and unconditional modes run on floppy and FAT16 fixed media; 2.88MB through legacy floppy layouts, hard-disk cancellation/errorlevel 5, system transfer, volume behavior, and rejection paths are asserted

GRAFTABL.COM.note: The multiplex handler, INT 1Fh vector, and exact 1,040-byte resident glyph table and metadata are asserted while switching 437 to 850 and back to 437

GRAPHICS.COM.note: Load, reload, profile, LCD, reverse, and background modes are asserted; a focused INT 5h probe prints a deterministic CGA pattern and requires the exact 17,781-byte LPT1 stream

HELP.COM.note: The deployed command renders its database-backed index, resolves a lowercase FORMAT topic with syntax, reports an unknown topic with errorlevel 1, and exposes /? usage

HIMEM.SYS.note: The shipped XMS 2.00 manager uses a 286 instruction baseline. A 286 runtime gate asserts installation, version, allocation, lock, unlock, and free; the 386+ gates additionally assert HMA ownership and thresholds, A20 backends and nesting, configurable handles, INT 15h reservation, documented options, move/resize, UMB request/release, repository EMM386 cooperation, rollback, EMS isolation, third-party DOS acquisition, and warm reboot. A cycle-oriented 286 move gate remains pending

IFSFUNC.EXE.note: NAMES=n overflow and repetition are rejected before a functional NAMES=7 installation; duplicate installation and the INT 21h attach, status, and detach bridge are exercised end to end against a purpose-built IFS with DOS resident low and high

IO.SYS.note: SYS-created media boots through the built BIOS and reaches DOS; CONFIG.SYS DOS= state, DEVICEHIGH/INSTALLHIGH placement, SIZE= parsing, directive-order independence, scoped UMB linkage, state restoration, and conventional fallback are asserted

JOIN.EXE.note: Join, listing, exact I/O, and removal are asserted; duplicate, missing, conflicting, unknown, excess, inactive-delete, nonempty-target, same-drive, and current-drive forms require exact diagnostics and errorlevel 1 without disturbing the live join

KEYB.COM.note: Multiple layouts, code pages, IDs, and a focused translated key are asserted

KEYBOARD.SYS.note: Explicit layout-file loading and translated keyboard behavior are asserted

LABEL.COM.note: Read, interactive set/delete, raw persistence, 11-character truncation, and invalid-character rejection with prior-label preservation are asserted

MEM.EXE.note: Basic, /PROGRAM, /C, /D, /F, and /M views are asserted against conventional, split-UMB, and HMA states; exact region accounting, case-insensitive syntax, missing-module errors, parser errors, and UMB-link restoration are covered

MIRROR.COM.note: Drive snapshots, retained prior generations, safe-FORMAT integration, deletion tracking setup, unconditional-format exclusion, and exact partition-table save/restore are exercised on real DOS media

MODE.COM.note: Console, serial, printer redirection, keyboard rate, and code-page behavior are asserted

MORE.COM.note: Short redirected input is asserted under kvikdos; a real DOS console test crosses two screen boundaries and proves all 60 numbered lines resume exactly once and in order after both extended and ordinary raw-key input

MSDOS.SYS.note: SYS-created media boots, the complete live INT 21h table is traced, arena/SFT/FAT exhaustion and recovery are asserted, asynchronous INT 23h/INT 28h paths run low and high, and two complete DOS=HIGH,UMB boots survive a warm reset

NLSFUNC.EXE.note: Default and explicit COUNTRY.SYS forms, unknown-switch and excess-operand rejection, resident duplicate handling, and code-page interaction are asserted

PRINT.COM.note: Queue configuration, add, cancel, and terminate operations are asserted; a focused test waits for queue completion and captures the exact payload plus final form feed from LPT1

PRINTER.SYS.note: The deployed driver and 4201 definition prepare and select code page 850 and report it active; exact PRINT payload capture separately proves ordinary LPT delivery, without treating BIOS fallback as proof of driver chaining

RAMDRIVE.SYS.note: The installed 64 KiB RAM disk returns exact DOS file payloads, exposes its 512-byte-sector and 128-sector BPB geometry, accepts an exact 512-byte write/readback at its final sector, remains isolated from VDISK, and returns exact status classes for all live request handlers plus the dispatch boundary

RECOVER.COM.note: File-mode recovery preserves exact bytes, while destructive drive mode rebuilds a private FAT directory as FILEnnnn.REC chains and preserves both payloads

REPLACE.EXE.note: All six documented modes and interactive confirmation are asserted; /A conflicts, every duplicate switch, an unknown switch, excess filespecs, and their source-defined errorlevels are covered

RESTORE.COM.note: All eight switches, positive and negative filtering, one-file and recursive media sets, interactive confirmation, directory reconstruction, existing-target handling, and binary-exact recovery are asserted; repeated valueless switches are proven idempotent, while unknown, excess-operand, invalid-date/time, and same-drive forms require exact diagnostics and nonzero errorlevels

SELECT.COM.note: BIOS-keyboard stub behavior and transition to SELECT.EXE are asserted

SELECT.EXE.note: Missing, unknown, and excess modes are rejected; recognized FDISK without SELECT.TMP returns with shell input still usable; MENU reaches Welcome, declines and recovers from exit, then re-enters and accepts exit back to DOS

SETVER.COM.note: The table is listed and modified through add, update, /DELETE and /D operations; /QUIET suppresses deletion output; edits persist in SETVER.EXE and child programs observe the requested versions

SETVER.EXE.note: DEVICE=SETVER.EXE loads the embedded 512-byte version table; additions and deletions made by SETVER.COM survive separate reboot cycles

SHARE.EXE.note: Installation options, duplicate detection, and actual byte locking are asserted

SMARTDRV.SYS.note: On a fixed disk the cache transitions disabled and enabled, applies policy changes, populates tracks from an exact 512-byte absolute-sector write/readback, persists that write-through payload byte-for-byte, and returns exact status classes for all live request handlers plus the dispatch boundary

SORT.EXE.note: Ascending ordering is asserted on the deployed floppy under DOS as well as through host execution; reverse and column-key sorting are asserted; /+n accepts both source-defined range endpoints 1 and 65535, rejects adjacent values, and an unknown switch returns errorlevel 1

SUBST.EXE.note: Subdirectory and root mapping, listing, exact I/O, pass-through, and removal are asserted; duplicate, missing, conflicting, unknown, excess, nonexistent-path, and inactive-delete forms require exact diagnostics and errorlevel 1 without disturbing the live mapping

SYS.COM.note: Default and explicit source forms produce bootable 1.44 and 2.88 MiB media; fresh and upgrade transfers preserve files and boot across small and large FAT16 fixed-disk BPBs; parser and read-only failures retain their historical status and leave rejected targets unchanged

TREE.COM.note: The deployed command traverses a purpose-built hierarchy and lists its leaf under DOS; tree-only, files, specific-path, and ASCII rendering are asserted; duplicate and unknown switches take the source-defined parser rejection path with errorlevel 1

UNDELETE.COM.note: DOS-directory and tracked recovery, listing, prompting, automatic collision naming, root and nested paths, FAT12/FAT16 chain restoration, exact payloads, and reused-cluster refusal are exercised

UNFORMAT.COM.note: Committed recovery generations are found independently of their formatted file chain, validated with /J, restored exactly after safe FORMAT, rejected after /U FORMAT, and partition-table geometry and bytes are verified

VDISK.SYS.note: The installed 64 KiB virtual disk returns exact DOS file payloads, exposes its 128-byte-sector and 512-sector BPB geometry, accepts an exact 128-byte write/readback at its final sector, remains isolated from RAMDRIVE, and returns exact status classes for all live request handlers plus the dispatch boundary

XCOPY.EXE.note: All eight DOS 4 switches and interactive confirmation are asserted; /A-/M ordering is verified through the resulting source archive bit, while every duplicate synonym, an unknown switch, excess filespecs, a pre-DOS date, and their exact parser diagnostics and errorlevel 4 are covered

XMA2EMS.SYS.note: The deployed driver gives its exact rejection on unsupported AT-compatible hardware, leaves no EMMXXXX0 device or LIM EMS vector resident, and lets DOS continue normally

XMAEM.SYS.note: The deployed driver gives its exact rejection on unsupported non-PS/2 hardware, leaves no 386XMAEM device resident, and lets DOS continue normally

MENU.note: The ordinary interactive path reaches Welcome and covers both decline and acceptance of the exit confirmation

FDISK.note: The reboot-continuation mode recognizes its missing SELECT.TMP state, returns to DOS, and leaves standard input usable

BUFFERS.note: Both configured buffer parameters are asserted through the DOS list of lists

COMMENT.note: An apparent BREAK override after COMMENT= is ignored and the original state remains active

COUNTRY.note: Country data loads and downstream code-page behavior is asserted

CPSW.note: CPSW=ON is accepted and AH=33h subfunctions 03h/04h are asserted as the intentionally inert DOS 4 compatibility interface

DEVICE.note: Multiple character, block, display, cache, and memory drivers are installed and exercised

DEVICEHIGH.note: Repository HIMEM and EMM386 integration proves upper placement, DOS= ordering independence, DOS 5 SIZE= parsing, scoped UMB linkage, caller-visible allocator restoration before INIT, conventional fallback without a provider, and live character- and block-driver retention

DOS.note: Case-insensitive HIGH/LOW and UMB/NOUMB combinations and repetition boot successfully; a synthetic XMS provider proves transactional rollback, while the real provider proves DOS=UMB retains an available but publicly unlinked upper arena

DRIVPARM.note: A nondefault B: geometry is configured and all form-factor, cylinder, sector, and head values are queried through generic IOCTL

FCBS.note: Configured FCB table and keep counts are asserted through the DOS list of lists

FILES.note: Configured system file-table capacity is summed through the DOS list of lists, then a FILES=12 boot exhausts the live SFT, asserts error 4, releases all handles, and reopens successfully

IFS.note: A purpose-built filesystem receives INIT, is found by name in the live IFS chain, and records exactly one runtime attach, status, and detach request

INSTALL.note: FASTOPEN is installed and resident behavior is subsequently exercised

INSTALLHIGH.note: A TSR is executed during CONFIG.SYS processing in upper memory with its argument tail intact; allocator state is restored, directive order is independent, and an absent provider falls back to conventional memory

LASTDRIVE.note: INT 21h/AH=0Eh reports all 26 configured CDS entries for LASTDRIVE=Z

MULTITRACK.note: Parallel fixed-disk reads spanning a track prove ON coalesces one 10-sector BIOS request while OFF splits it into two requests

REM.note: An apparent BREAK override after REM is ignored and the original state remains active

SHELL.note: Configured COMMAND.COM starts, processes AUTOEXEC, and remains operational

STACKS.note: Parallel STACKS=0,0 and STACKS=9,256 boots prove the configured internal stack pool reserves the required DOS memory

SWITCHES.note: An INT 16h hook proves /K changes DOS CON input from extended AH=10h to conventional AH=00h
